title: MCookieClicker
description: A fully configurable Cookie Clicker plugin with buildings, upgrades, particles, progression system, and optimized performance.
body:
# MCookieClicker

Bring the classic Cookie Clicker experience directly into Minecraft!

MCookieClicker is a fully configurable and performance-optimized plugin inspired by the popular Cookie Clicker game. Players can click cookies, buy buildings, unlock upgrades, purchase particles, and build their very own cookie empire.

Perfect for survival servers, minigames, CityBuild, economy servers, or community projects.

## Features

* Complete Cookie Clicker system
* Click and earn cookies
* Buy buildings for passive income
* Unlock upgrades and multipliers
* Purchase particles and cosmetic effects
* Progression system with long-term motivation
* Fully configurable
* Customizable GUIs and messages
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Easy setup
* Modern and clean design

## Included Systems

### Cookie System

Players can click cookies and continuously increase their cookie count.

### Buildings

Buy buildings that automatically generate cookies.

### Upgrades

Improve your production with powerful upgrades and boosts.

### Particles & Cosmetics

Unlock various particles and personalize your gameplay experience.

### Progression System

Balanced system designed for long-term fun and player motivation.

## Why MCookieClicker?

* Lightweight and efficient
* Beginner-friendly
* Designed for modern Minecraft servers
* Very easy to customize
* Focused on performance and stability
* Perfect for long-term player engagement
